title: Add ADE acceptance report primitives
prompt: Implement acceptance-report primitives for ADE. Add src/ade/acceptance.py with an immutable CheckResult dataclass containing name: str, passed: bool, and detail: str = ""; and an immutable AcceptanceReport dataclass containing results: tuple[CheckResult, ...]. AcceptanceReport must expose total, passed_count, failed_count, and complete properties, where complete is true only when there is at least one result and all results pass. Validate that CheckResult.name is non-empty. Add a public build_report(results) helper that returns an AcceptanceReport from any iterable of CheckResult. Add focused tests using Python standard-library unittest only. Do not add dependencies. Do not modify GOAL.md, SPEC.md, ACCEPTANCE.md, ROADMAP.md, pyproject.toml, .github/workflows, or any .autodev files. Run exactly PYTHONPATH=src python -m unittest discover -s tests -v before finishing.
